sentences.text: Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with a case for the offence punishable under sections 272, 273, 284/34 of I.P.C, Sections 26 (2) (i) and (iv) of the Food Safety Standard Act, 2006 and sections 2, 3 and 4 of the Exchange Act, who is one of the named accused in this case but only on disclosure of two co- apprehended accused carrying band article 'Gutka' in pick up van said to have been belonging to the petitioner.
Submission is of false implication and except above there is absolutely nothing against him who carries no criminal antecedent.

If it is so, in the event of arrest/surrender before the court below within four weeks, the above named petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand)
with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of C.J.M. Muzaffarpur in Town P.S.
Case No. 261 of 2013, subject to the conditions as laid down in section 438 (2) of Cr.P.C. with additional condition to remain physically present before the court below on each and every date at least for two years or till disposal of the case whichever is earlier and in case of failure on two consecutive dates without giving any reasonable explanation, the privilege granted shall be deemed to be cancelled (Akhilesh Chandra, J) Abhay/-

3 24-12-2013 Heard the parties.
Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with a case for the offence punishable under sections 272, 273, 284/34 of I.P.C, Sections 26 (2) (i) and (iv) of the Food Safety Standard Act, 2006 and sections 2, 3 and 4 of the Exchange Act, who is one of the named accused in this case but only on disclosure of two co- apprehended accused carrying band article 'Gutka' in pick up van said to have been belonging to the petitioner.
Submission is of false implication and except above there is absolutely nothing against him who carries no criminal antecedent.

with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of C.J.M. Muzaffarpur in Town P.S.
Case No. 261 of 2013, subject to the conditions as laid down in section 438 (2) of Cr.P.C. with additional condition to remain physically present before the court below on each and every date at least for two years or till disposal of the case whichever is earlier and in case of failure on two consecutive dates without giving any reasonable explanation, the privilege granted shall be deemed to be cancelled (Akhilesh Chandra, J) Abhay/-
